set_cpu_affinity_for_gpu: set CPU affinity for a given GPU index using a specified mode
get_thread_siblings_list: get thread siblings list for CPU cores from /sys/devices/system/cpu
get_gpu_cpu_affinity: get the CPU core affinity list assigned to a specific GPU device
set_socket_unique_affinity: set socket-unique CPU affinity with interleaved or continuous mode for multi-GPU
get_gpu_device_name: get the name of an NVIDIA GPU device by its index
